Claire / team — thanks for the context. A few legal clarifications so procurement and the broker can line up with the insurers: 

1) Additional Insured naming: please ensure the endorsement explicitly states "Redwood Inference, Inc." as an Additional Insured and includes our corporate address (505 Howard St., San Francisco, CA 94105). Language along the lines of "is amended to include as an Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents, but only with respect to liability arising out of the named insured's operations performed for the Additional Insured under written contract" is preferred. If the insurer offers broader or narrower language, send both copies for review.

2) ACORD 25 vs endorsement: an ACORD 25 COI is fine for initial review, but we need the actual CGL endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) to confirm Additional Insured status — the COI alone is not proof of coverage. If the endorsement cannot be issued before signature, a binder or insurer-written confirmation that the endorsement will be issued upon execution is acceptable.

3) Policy identifiers: please include insurer name, NAIC number, policy number, effective/expiry dates and insurer contact (phone/email) on the COI. We will need to validate by contacting the carrier if anything looks inconsistent.

4) Waiver of subrogation: acceptable if carrier confirms in-writing and it does not create a conflict with state workers' comp requirements. Provide the exact waiver language the carrier will put on the endorsement/COI for our review.

5) Cyber coverage: if NovaCloud will be processing customer data or storing customer data for Redwood, please obtain a certificate for cyber/privacy liability (limits) or an endorsement that includes contractual liability for data incidents. If the carrier does not offer cyber, we will need additional mitigations documented.

Please ask broker/insurer to provide: ACORD 25 (stamped preferred), the CGL Additional Insured endorsement PDF, and a contact person at the insurer who can confirm issuance timelines. If available, include the insurer's binder or a signed letter confirming the endorsement will be effective on policy issuance.

I can review any endorsement language quickly — please send as soon as you have it.
